title: E0037: String Offset Out of Bounds
plain_english: Reports string offsets that can be out of bounds.
why_matters: Accessing a string offset outside its valid range can produce warnings and unexpected values. This rule uses Phanalist's bounded formal verification engine (Z3-backed) to detect feasible out-of-bounds string accesses.
bad_example:
<?php
function lastChar(string $s): string
{
    return $s[strlen($s)]; // off by one
}
good_example:
<?php
function lastChar(string $s): string
{
    if ($s === '') {
        return '';
    }

    return $s[strlen($s) - 1];
}
what_it_checks: Lengths derived from `strlen()`, `str_repeat()` with a literal repetition count, `substr()` using PHP's offset and length rules, `str_split()` using a literal chunk size, and `str_pad()` with a literal non-empty pad string
Symbolic offsets and guards in branches and short-circuit conditions
Offsets that cannot be modeled report `unverified` under `unknown_policy: report`
